text:
maria: Heads up — Legal updated preferred phrasing for a few market-specific pages. We should replace 'data residency' and 'sovereignty' with 'in-country data hosting' where it applies (FR, CA, HK). Also need to add a brief explainer about how hosted endpoints route by region vs Dedicated/Private options. Who can take a short PR to sweep docs + SDK snippets?

alex: I can handle the SDK snippets (node + python). Will also add an example header for users that want to pin region.

jen: Confirming the wording: use 'in-country data hosting' and 'geographic availability' as the pair. Avoid 'sovereignty' and 'localization' in legal copy. Also add link to the legal appendix we keep up-to-date.

oliver: I'll run a repo search and draft a docs PR. Suggestion: use ripgrep to find occurrences: `rg "data residency|data-residency|sovereignty|region(?:al)? residency"` and then apply replacements manually.

simone: Small ops note — for Dedicated customers we should link to Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) page, and call out KMS/HSM behavior. I'll add a checklist item in the PR description so reviewers don't miss infra notes.

alex: Draft snippet for header-based pinning (Node):
```js
// Pin requests to EU-hosted model variants
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood/gpt-large',
  input: 'Summarize quarterly results',
  headers: { 'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu-west-1' }
});
```
Also Python snippet:
```py
# Pin to in-country endpoint behavior via header
resp = client.responses.create(
  model='redwood/gpt-large',
  input='Translate to fr',
  headers={'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu-west-1'}
)
```
Note: these headers are supported on Hosted for routing hints; Dedicated/Private customers should use the deployment config instead.

maria: Perfect — please add a short inline note in each SDK example: "This is a routing hint; it does not change the customer's data controls for dedicated/private deployments."

oliver: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9842 (WIP). I added a replacement summary and a preview page for FR/CA pages.

doc-bot: @docs-bot checklist — ran linter, flagged 7 pages with 'sovereignty' still present. See /lint-report/2419876543.

jen: Thanks, oliver — can you leave the legal appendix link in each edited page: https://internal.redwood/legal/region-phrasing v2? That's the canonical text.

simone: Also add a short note on the region matrix (table) that shows which models are available per region; product asked to include model parity note.

alex: I'll push SDK PRs into the same docs PR as commits (node + python). Will also include a tiny test under examples/ that asserts the header is present in generated cURL from snippets.

oliver: Updated PR description with checklist: 1) Replace wording, 2) Add SDK header samples, 3) Add crosslinks to Private/Dedicated, 4) Run i18n sweep.

maria: Great. Who will handle translations? We need French translations for the FR pages before merge.

jen: Localization team — can you add `i18n-needed: fr` label on the PR and ping @translation-queue? Also legal will do a quick spot-check on FR page after translation.

oliver: Done — label added. Also added a small test change that updates the region table snippet to show "In-country data hosting (FR: yes)".

alex: Pushed two commits: `sdk: add region header examples (node,py)` and `tests: assert header included in codegen` — PR now contains 5 commits.

doc-bot: CI: staging build started for PR #9842.

maria: Thanks all. Once staging passes and translations land, we can merge. Follow-up: please post a short note in #general when live so product and sales see updated wording. :thumbsup:

oliver: Will follow up with a one-line release note and the list of updated pages.

alex: If anyone wants to test snippets locally: example cURL to mimic header: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large","input":"test"}'`

jen: Legal approves the wording. :white_check_mark:

doc-bot: CI: staging build passed for PR #9842. Merge pending reviews.

maria: I'll review for product phrasing after lunch. If no blockers, merge by EOD.

oliver: Merged to main at 2419877640. Release notes queued.
